header.title: Assets
empty.noAssetsDesc: Import a configurations export from ITGlue, ConnectWise, or another CMDB to build your inventory. Once imported, you can correlate security events against it.
table.name: Name
correlate.needInventory: Import a CMDB export first — there is nothing to correlate against yet.
correlate.noObservables: No correlatable observables were found in that event. Expected columns such as Source IP, Destination IP, Source Host, or Source Mac.
correlate.intro: Import a security event export to match its network observables against your asset inventory. Results are graded by confidence:
correlate.legendExact: Exact — a unique identifier (MAC, serial, IP, or hostname) matched a configuration item.
correlate.legendSubnet: Subnet — no asset owns the address, but inventoried assets share its /24. Useful context, not identification.
correlate.legendGap: Coverage gap — an internal host or address with no CMDB record at all.
surface.emptyDesc: Import a CMDB export to see which products you run and which threats apply to them.
surface.summary: {{atRisk}} of {{total}} assets run software that is out of mainstream support. {{unidentified}} assets could not be identified from their inventory record.
surface.applicabilityPlaceholder: Paste a CVE, CPE, or advisory text…
surface.indeterminate: Not enough detail to determine applicability. Provide a product name, vendor, or CPE.
surface.notApplicable: Not applicable — no asset in the inventory runs an affected product.
surface.keywordWarning: Matched on advisory keywords only. Treat these as leads to verify, not confirmed exposure.
surface.eolDisclaimer: Lifecycle dates reviewed {{date}}. Vendors change these — verify against the vendor advisory before acting.
detail.affectsMatching: Corrections to this field change correlation and attack surface results
detail.analystNotesPlaceholder: Findings from investigations. Never overwritten by a CMDB import.
field.name: Name
owner.importDesc: A CMDB export has no organization column, so every row in this file will be labelled with what you choose here.
owner.assignPrompt: Assign an owner to all {{count}} assets currently shown.
